name: kubed
description: Agent skills from kubed-io, one plugin per tool.

plugins.name: drawio
plugins.description: Draw and edit draw.io diagrams: small, cheap edits to the diagram open in a live editor through lgazo/drawio-mcp-server, or .drawio files when none is open. Icon styles that render, a map of draw.io's docs, and prompts to draw, edit, tidy and explain.

plugins.name: ultrapowers
plugins.description: The turns of an issue-to-pull-request agent flow, as prompts on top of superpowers: draft the spec, plan once it is approved, build the plan a task at a time, answer failed checks and reviews, review the change with a security pass by a subagent, and assess a bug without fixing it.

plugins.name: kubed-claude
plugins.description: Field notes on Claude Code, checked by running it: what a subagent really gets, agent files and their MCP servers, prompts as plugin commands and MCP prompts, MCP config and skills served over MCP, and headless runs. Grows as we learn.
